current_suggestion.pitch: Your list is strong on tactics (poker, nutrition, training) and on Stoic practice, but light on the philosophy of mind behind the inner game. Harris covers attention, the nature of the thinking self, meditation, free will and how beliefs form. These are the foundations of tilt, emotional regulation and decision-making under pressure. The format is long-form, one-on-one interviews with scientists and philosophers (AI safety and neuroscience come up often) plus occasional solo talks. It's a different, more secular and introspective angle than Daily Stoic. Skip the episodes that drift into politics.
